يتناوب (form VI)

# يَتَنَاوَبَ (yatanāwaba) /ja.ta.naː.wa.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
# يَتَنَاوَبْ (yatanāwab) /ja.ta.naː.wab/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
